page.layout: One printed page of text, no margin notes. Full-width dedication heading at top (ornament, then centred title block with salutation and "S. P."). Below it, one paragraph with a decorated initial, running to the foot. Signature "A 2" at the bottom centre.

main_text.head: EXCELL. VIRIS, D. Felici Platero, Archiatro Practico, D. Thomae Coccio Ethico, D. Petro Riffio Mathematico, Medicinae Doctoribus praestantissimis atq; in Basil. illustri Acad. Antecessoribus dignissimis, Dominis & Patronis suis summa observantia colendis, S. P.
main_text.p: NOTAM[?] Hominis felicitatem (Viri clarissimi) in eo positam esse praedicat divinus Ecclesiastes: ut Deum revereatur, ejusq; praecepta observet. Etenim cum Deus omnia propter semetipsum fecerit: atq; adeo universa Creatura ad omnipotentis sui Creatoris gloriam concelebrandā, uno quasi impetu feruntur: tum vero maxime Homo, creaturarum rerum aspectabilium nobilissima & absolutissima: quippe ad Imaginem[?] Dei conditus, intellectu mentěq; divinâ prorsus exornatus: suae conditionis finem accuratè semper & ubique meditari debebat. Quod tamen omne (proh dolor).

page.notes: The decorated initial is a woodcut and its letter is hard to make out; I read it as N, so the word is given as NOTAM with [?]. The word after "ad" in "ad Imaginem" is partly damaged; the final letters are read as "em" with [?]. The ornament above the heading is not text. The "A 2" signature is printed at the foot. No running head or page number is printed. Handwriting in the lower left margin is not transcribed. The dedication heading is set in capitals and spaced type, so it is given as a level 1 heading.
